name: Summon Angelic Guardian
description: (Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a low-ranking Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Lesser Light Fairy, Angel Guardians, Archangel Flames (Overlord), 2 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Uncommon familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.
